title: monAp_pg — Capacity planning
description: Capacity planning : évolution de la taille des bases, projections à 1 mois / 6 mois / 1 an et plus grosses tables.

list.name: instance
list.label: Instance
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, instance_id AS __value FROM asemon.instances WHERE enabled ORDER BY instance_id
list.definition: SELECT name AS __text, instance_id AS __value FROM asemon.instances WHERE enabled ORDER BY instance_id

list.name: db
list.label: Base
list.query: SELECT label AS __text, val AS __value FROM (SELECT '(toutes les bases)' AS label, '__all__' AS val, 0 AS ord UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT datname, datname, 1 FROM asemon.snap_db_size WHERE instance_id = $instance) t ORDER BY ord, label
list.definition: SELECT label AS __text, val AS __value FROM (SELECT '(toutes les bases)' AS label, '__all__' AS val, 0 AS ord UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT datname, datname, 1 FROM asemon.snap_db_size WHERE instance_id = $instance) t ORDER BY ord, label

panels.title: Taille de la base
panels.description: Taille cumulée (octets) relevée une fois par heure. L'historique commence au déploiement de la collecte. Au-delà de 7 jours, un point par jour est conservé (voir retention.py).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT collected_at AS time, sum(size_bytes) AS "Taille"
FROM asemon.snap_db_size WHERE instance_id = $instance AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND ('${db}' = '__all__' OR datname = '${db}')
GROUP BY collected_at ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Taille actuelle
panels.description: Dernière taille relevée avant la fin de la période affichée.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s AS "Taille actuelle" FROM (
  SELECT collected_at, sum(size_bytes) AS s FROM asemon.snap_db_size WHERE instance_id = $instance AND collected_at <= $__timeTo() AND ('${db}' = '__all__' OR datname = '${db}')
  GROUP BY collected_at ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1) x

panels.title: Dans 1 mois
panels.description: Taille actuelle + pente × 30 jours. Extrapolation linéaire (régression sur la période affichée), à périmètre constant. Affichée seulement si l'historique couvre au moins 48 h.

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT collected_at, sum(size_bytes)::float8 AS s
  FROM asemon.snap_db_size WHERE instance_id = $instance AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND ('${db}' = '__all__' OR datname = '${db}')
  GROUP BY collected_at
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) >= 2 AND max(collected_at) - min(collected_at) >= interval '48 hours'
  THEN GREATEST(0, (array_agg(s ORDER BY collected_at DESC))[1]
       + regr_slope(s, extract(epoch FROM collected_at)) * 30 * 86400) END AS "Dans 1 mois"
FROM p

panels.title: Les 10 plus grosses tables
panels.description: Classées par taille totale (table + index + TOAST) à la dernière collecte. « Index » = nombre d'index. « Lignes » est une estimation (n_live_tup, à défaut reltuples). « Taille dans 6 mois » : régression linéaire sur la période affichée, à périmètre constant (sans nouvelle table ni purge), affichée si l'historique couvre au moins 48 h. Les partitions apparaissent comme des tables distinctes.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT max(collected_at) AS t FROM asemon.snap_table_size WHERE instance_id = $instance AND collected_at <= $__timeTo()
), cur AS (
  SELECT s.* FROM asemon.snap_table_size s, latest l
  WHERE s.collected_at = l.t AND ('${db}' = '__all__' OR s.datname = '${db}')
), reg AS (
  SELECT datname, schemaname, relname,
         count(*) AS n,
         max(collected_at) - min(collected_at) AS span,
         regr_slope(total_bytes::float8, extract(epoch FROM collected_at)) AS slope
  FROM asemon.snap_table_size WHERE instance_id = $instance AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) AND ('${db}' = '__all__' OR datname = '${db}')
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT c.datname AS "Base",
       c.schemaname || '.' || c.relname AS "Table",
       c.index_count AS "Index",
       c.row_estimate AS "Lignes",
       c.total_bytes AS "Taille",
       CASE WHEN r.n >= 2 AND r.span >= interval '48 hours'
            THEN GREATEST(0, c.total_bytes + r.slope * 182 * 86400) END AS "Taille dans 6 mois"
FROM cur c
LEFT JOIN reg r USING (datname, schemaname, relname)
ORDER BY c.total_bytes DESC
LIMIT 10
